description: Work with structured databases (typed tables of rows; `docs` listings mark them doc_type:"database"). action: list (databases you can reach in the workspace) | schema (`database_id`: tables, columns, physical SQL names, row counts, saved views, and the standing `instructions` people set for the database — follow them when changing it) | status (`database_id`: what the user decided about your recent changes) | page (`database_id`, `table`, `row_id`: the doc_id of the row's PAGE — a prose document linked to that row — or null when it has none; read and edit a page with `markdown` like any document). Your own schema reads include your pending changes. Read rows with `query`. Change a database with `databases_add` (new tables, columns, rows, imports, views and pages) or `databases_change` (update or delete rows, change a view).

workspace_id.description: The workspace to act in: a `workspace_id` from `workspaces` action:list, which also says which node it is on.
